clips.title: The story
paras: Foreman Stonebrow is a dwarven overseer representing the Miners' League at Gol'Bolar Quarry in eastern Dun Morogh. After aggressive troggs erupted from the rock and overran the excavation site, he was forced to organize a defense and hire adventurers to clear the pits.

Foreman Stonebrow was charged with directing operations at Gol'Bolar Quarry, a key dwarven excavation nestled in the mountains east of Kharanos. When deep digging broke into hidden trogg burrows, subterranean beasts swarmed the pits and drove the miners from their equipment. Refusing to abandon the site entirely, Stonebrow remains at the rim of the quarry to enlist any able-bodied travelers willing to push the troggs back.
